'''2017 US Nationals Day 2 Matt Carulli DS Combat Readiness (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Matt Carulli]] at [[2017 U.S. National Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Matt Carulli]]
* '''Event:''' [[2017 U.S. National Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Combat Readiness (V)|Endor-D-combatreadiness.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open Combat Readiness (V) Carulli DS.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/resources/tournament-decklists/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013125443/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/tournament-decklists.html Internet Archive]
